articles.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
articles.snippet: A December rate hike appears completely assured, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

articles.title: Ripple Prime head Marc Asch to step down, Noel Kimmel named successor
articles.snippet: Asch is stepping down as head of the institutional prime brokerage.

articles.title: Bitcoin lags stock rebound in advance of U.S. inflation report
articles.snippet: Bitcoin slipped despite a Monday rebound in U.S. stocks, with spot ETFs losing $201 million as traders await October inflation data later today.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips before U.S. inflation report as traders price in Fed rate increase
articles.snippet: Fed Governor Waller backs December tightening even if inflation cools, while falling oil prices offer some relief and Anthropic withdraws IPO pricing details.

articles.title: Coinbase, Kalshi, Kraken parent back CFTC in legal fight over stock perpetual futures
articles.snippet: The Capital Markets Alliance argues that the products fall under the Securities and Exchange Commission’s jurisdiction.
